personas.ai_literacy_level: Low: Minimal understanding of generative AI systems. Rarely recognises common AI-generated patterns and has limited awareness of how AI content is produced.
personas.prior_ai_use: None: No meaningful prior interaction with generative AI tools.
personas.online_content_skepticism: Low: Generally accepts online content at face value and rarely questions authenticity unless obvious issues are present.
personas.attention_to_detail: Medium: Pays attention to noticeable details but may not consistently inspect all aspects of the content carefully.
personas.prior_exposure_to_misinformation: Medium: Some prior exposure to misinformation, fake news, or online discussions about deceptive content.
